creators.name: Thériault, Rémi
creators.affiliation: Université du Québec à Rimouski; New York University

abstract: A Tier-3 direct-effect forecast for the Silicon Sample Benchmark from Anthropic Claude Opus 4.6. Two fixed prompts elicited all 13 average treatment effects for each of 16 interventions. The two prompt-level forecasts were aggregated by their median. The entry contains 208 predictions in original outcome units and applies no post-hoc calibration or shrinkage.
approach_family: direct effect forecasting, single-model LLM, zero-shot structured prompting, prompt-median aggregation
models: anthropic.claude-opus-4-6 via Vertex AI and the NYU AI Gateway
